name: One Starcaller Celestial Mind per caster on each recipient (#5167)
contract: Celestial Mind ranks 1-5 share the chain 300255 -> 301222 -> 301223 -> 301224 -> 301225 (spell_ranks, rev_20260903_01) and Greater Celestial Mind 680301 is unranked; no spell_group listed them, so Aura::CanStackWith let the normal and greater versions stay on one recipient (#5167). They share spell group 1142 with stack rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER): the newest replaces the caster's previous one, while a second Starcaller's still coexists - the same shape as the Templar Gift (1140) group. Only the first rank is listed because SpellMgr::LoadSpellGroups drops any other rank and chains resolve through GetFirstSpellInChain.

steps.label: Greater Celestial Mind from the same caster
It replaced the same caster's Celestial Mind
A second Starcaller gives Celestial Mind
The other caster's Celestial Mind coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
